title: The Road into the City
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever been part of something joyful that you did not fully understand — but joined in anyway?
reflectionText: Jesus sent two disciples for a donkey and a colt. He sat on the colt, and the crowd erupted. People threw their cloaks on the road. They cut branches from the trees. They shouted Hosanna. Most did not know what was coming next — the week ahead held betrayal and arrest and crucifixion. What is it to lay down what you have and join the procession before you know where it leads?
